mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO sq_auth_rate_bucket (bucket_key, window_start, failures) VALUES (#{bucketKey}, #{now}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_auth_rate_bucket SET failures = CASE WHEN window_start < DATE_SUB(#{now}, INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) THEN 1 ELSE failures + 1 END, locked_until = CASE WHEN window_start >= DATE_SUB(#{now}, INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) AND failures >= 4 THEN DATE_ADD(#{now}, INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) ELSE NULL END, window_start = CASE WHEN window_start < DATE_SUB(#{now}, INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) THEN #{now} ELSE window_start END WHERE bucket_key = #{bucketKey}
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, username, display_name, password_hash, role, status, auth_version, must_change_password, version FROM sq_user WHERE username = #{username} AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT s.session_id, s.user_id, u.username, u.role, u.must_change_password, s.token_hash, s.csrf_hash, s.issued_auth_version, u.auth_version, u.status, s.last_seen_at, s.idle_expires_at, s.absolute_expires_at, s.revoked_at FROM sq_auth_session s JOIN sq_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id AND u.del_flag = '0' WHERE s.token_hash = #{tokenHash}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sq_auth_session (session_id, user_id, token_hash, csrf_hash, issued_auth_version, created_at, last_seen_at, idle_expires_at, absolute_expires_at) VALUES (#{session.sessionId}, #{session.userId}, #{session.tokenHash}, #{session.csrfHash}, #{session.issuedAuthVersion}, #{lastSeenAt}, #{lastSeenAt}, #{session.idleExpiresAt}, #{session.absoluteExpiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_auth_session SET last_seen_at = #{lastSeenAt}, idle_expires_at = LEAST(absolute_expires_at, #{idleExpiresAt}) WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND last_seen_at < DATE_SUB(#{lastSeenAt}, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)
mapper.select: SELECT window_start, failures, locked_until FROM sq_auth_rate_bucket WHERE bucket_key = #{bucketKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sq_auth_audit (event_id, user_id, actor_user_id, event_type, result, occurred_at, request_id) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{userId}, #{actorUserId}, #{eventType}, #{result}, #{occurredAt}, #{requestId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sq_auth_session WHERE absolute_expires_at < #{now} OR (revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at < #{now}) LIMIT 1000
DELETE FROM sq_auth_rate_bucket WHERE window_start < #{before} AND (locked_until IS NULL OR locked_until < #{before}) LIMIT 1000
